character.name: Victor Hale
character.biography: Victor Hale is a fictional antiques dealer crossing at Alder Crossing. Charming, polished, redirects to pleasantries; defensive when shown receipt.
character.speech_style: Charming, polished, redirects to pleasantries; defensive when shown receipt.
character.compliance_bounds: Readily adopts wording that gets him admitted, including denying belongings when told that is the price of passage. Charming compliance can contradict his prior claims; cargo and documents remain real. Refuses to volunteer a new criminal confession without evidence.

truth.purpose: Deliver three crates of undeclared antiques for sale at Hale Gallery.
truth.itinerary: Hale Gallery appointment Saturday 10:00; return Sunday.
truth.cargo: Three crates of antiques for commercial resale, undeclared.
documents: Cargo receipt VH-31: three crates, Hale Gallery, Saturday 10:00, commercial sale.

public_claims.text: Only personal luggage. Nothing for sale.

evidence.description: Cargo receipt VH-31: three crates, Hale Gallery, Saturday 10:00, commercial sale.
Trunk inspection: three crates of antiques; invoice VH-31 marked commercial resale.

contradictions.explanation: The claim "Only personal luggage. Nothing for sale." is contradicted by Cargo receipt VH-31: three crates, Hale Gallery, Saturday 10:00, commercial sale.
The claim "Only personal luggage. Nothing for sale." is contradicted by Trunk inspection: three crates of antiques; invoice VH-31 marked commercial resale.

opening_line: Lovely day, officer. Just a personal visit, just my luggage. Shall we make this quick?

actor.purpose: A personal visit. I am not here on business.
actor.itinerary: I will be back Sunday. Just visiting.
actor.cargo: Only personal luggage. Nothing for sale.
actor.repeat: As I said, it is a personal visit. Surely we need not rehearse every word?
actor.irrelevant: That is an unusual question. Do you collect antiques yourself?
actor.confront: All right. Those crates are for Hale Gallery. I did not declare the sale goods.
